description: Authored fictional engineering log with frozen gold facts for a reproducible smoke comparison.
document: A laboratory evaluated the fictional Cedar-17 data logger. With the ceramic probe it recorded one sample every 37 seconds. The field trial lasted 14 days. A later trial used a metal probe with a 61-second interval. Neither trial measured battery lifetime.

cases.question: What was the sampling interval of the Cedar-17 ceramic probe? Answer in seconds.
Compare the two Cedar-17 probes' sampling intervals, in seconds.
What battery lifetime did the Cedar-17 trials measure?
cases.gold_regex: (?i)(did not measure|not measured|neither trial measured|insufficient evidence|didn.t measure|not reported)
